Hi Marissa,

I attached our standard PO template and a copy of our W-9 for your records. If Redwood needs an amendment or signature on your side, please let me know how to execute it (DocuSign is preferred).

- Accept single aggregated PO for renewal + expansion
- Consolidated monthly invoice to finance@atlasedge.com
- Change net terms to Net45 starting with July invoice
- Confirm any documentation Redwood needs (we attached PO + W-9)

Thanks — appreciate your help on timing.

Marissa / Tessa —

We can do this in principle. A few implementation notes from finance/ops:

- Aggregated PO: fine from an invoicing perspective as long as the PO references the Redwood contract/agreement number (we should ask Kelly to include the RDW contract id or we can map it on our side).
- Consolidated monthly invoice: we can cut a single invoice each month covering all charge types (hosted + dedicated) provided the billing entity remains the same. If AtlasEdge is splitting payments across legal entities, that becomes more complex.
- Net45: acceptable as an exception tied to this renewal; finance needs a signed amendment (DocuSign) that references the term change and effective date.
- W-9: verify EIN on file matches the W-9. Tessa — can you confirm?

Operational next steps I recommend we send Kelly a DocuSign amendment (I can draft language) and a short PO checklist for AP to include on the PO (contract id, billing entity, billing email). Once signed, we’ll schedule billing to switch the term for invoices dated >= 2028-07-01.

Marissa — please confirm you’re ok with the messaging and I’ll prepare the DocuSign powerform.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Customer Success
